row.notes: Read in full: (sys, out, telemetry, player, carIdx, aiCtl) fills 0x6c-byte record out+player*0x6c from per-car telemetry (stride 0x3b/0x39/0x2e/0x5b4): rev % /100, gear, speed km/h or mph (/1.609344 by unit flags +0x311/+0x313) logged 'Speed (%d) = %.2f', rpm ratio, flag states 1..4, DRS, pit/limiter, lap time ms, sector data; logs 'Player%d car Index: %d' and 'AI control sync check %d'; sets *out = 1. Only refs are calls from 0x155579420. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_WheelLights_FillPlayerRecord (bound record keeps its name).
